content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITION_OF_CONFIDENTIAL_INFORMATION
content_blocks.text: Confidential Information means any and all information disclosed by the Disclosing Party that is designated as confidential or that should reasonably be understood to be confidential given the nature of the information and the circumstances of disclosure.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_OBLIGATIONS_OF_THE_RECEPTING_PARTY
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party shall hold the Confidential Information in strict confidence and shall not disclose it to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.2_EXCEPTIONS
content_blocks.text: Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information to its employees, agents, and advisors who have a need to know such information for the purpose of performing their duties under this Agreement.
